purpose: A1 (research/53): 300 new random WWSSN long-period vertical (LHZ) film chips; file names are compared with what the chip shows

enumeration.method: HTML directory listings (served as plain HTML to non-browser clients); no index or JSON listing found

rule: pool = sorted(LHZ names minus exclusions); order = numpy.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(len(pool)); walk pool[order[k]] for k = 0, 1, ...: take unless its station already has 4 picks; skip (and go on) if Content-Length > 80 MB or the download fails twice (one retry); stop at 300 picks
